title: DCN V2: Improved Deep & Cross Network and Practical Lessons for Web-scale Learning to Rank Systems
layout_note: Both panels are the proposed model in two arrangements (stacked vs parallel), not proposed-vs-baseline.
grouping: Two variants of the same network side by side: a stacked structure at left (embedding, then cross network, then deep network, one above the other) and a parallel structure at right (cross and deep networks side by side over a shared embedding). Each sub-network is a thin black dotted rectangle with a small grey label inside its corner (Embedding Layer, Cross Network, Deep Netwrok). A small legend box at the top centre lists the circle colours.
shapes_depth: Every layer is a dashed rounded pill holding a row of filled circles, labelled at its right in bold math (x0, x1, x2, x_l1, h1, h2). Circle colours encode role: dense features orange, sparse features light orange, embeddings light grey, cross-layer units yellow, deep-layer units taupe, output dark olive. Cross operations are small circled-x glyphs fed by a thin black skip line from x0 running up the left side; a circled-slash glyph marks the deep-layer step. Inputs enter as orange circles at the bottom with short arrows; vertical dots stand for omitted layers. Flat, no shadows.
proposed_highlight: No single element is singled out; the proposed cross layers are the yellow rows, distinct from the taupe deep layers, and the figure presents both proposed arrangements at equal size.
lesson: Draw each layer's vector as a row of circles in a dashed pill, coloured by role (dense/sparse input, embedding, cross, deep) with one legend, and route the x0 skip line up the side into every ⊗ so the cross structure reads without text.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2008.13535); venue WWW from Semantic Scholar (venue_source: semantic-scholar), not stated on the PDF's first page. 'Deep Netwrok' is spelled so in the figure. elements 'other' = neuron circles inside dashed layer pills.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
